lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains between three and five visible centroids within the central lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as high-intensity nodes within the stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large commensal fish (remora) is visible in the lower-left quadrant, oriented horizontally across the lower flank and pectoral fin region.
